# `silk/platform/windows/wtf8`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Lossless conversion between Windows UTF-16 code units and canonical WTF-8 bytes.

## When to use
Use `Wtf8.encode` for raw host values and `Wtf8.decodeBytes` for their inverse. Lone surrogates
remain bytes. Use `String.fromUtf8` separately when a caller needs valid Unicode text.

Import as `Wtf8` with `import silk.platform.windows.wtf8 { Wtf8 }`.

<a id="Wtf8.impl.encode"></a>

### Associated function `encode`

```silk
pub effect fn encode(units: &[u16]) -> Bytes ! OutOfMemoryError ? &mut Allocator
```

Returns canonical WTF-8 bytes for `units`. Pairs become one scalar; lone surrogates survive.

#### Details

NUL is preserved. Host APIs that use NUL terminators must reject embedded NUL separately.

#### Errors

- `OutOfMemoryError` if the output cannot be allocated.

<a id="Wtf8.impl.pointBytes"></a>

### Associated function `pointBytes`

```silk
pub fn pointBytes(bytes: &[u8], at: usize) -> Option<Wtf8Point>
```

Decodes one canonical WTF-8 code point at `at`, or returns an absent option for invalid input.

#### Details

An absent result also indicates the end of input. Callers start at zero and advance to `end`.
Overlong encodings, values above 0x10ffff, and separately encoded adjacent surrogate pairs are rejected.
Lone surrogates and NUL are accepted. This operation does not allocate.

<a id="Wtf8.impl.decodeBytes"></a>

### Associated function `decodeBytes`

```silk
pub effect fn decodeBytes(bytes: &[u8]) -> List<u16> ! InvalidWtf8 | OutOfMemoryError ? &mut Allocator
```

Returns the UTF-16 code units of canonical WTF-8 bytes, preserving lone surrogates and NUL.

#### Errors

- `InvalidWtf8` for malformed bytes or separately encoded adjacent high and low surrogates.
- `OutOfMemoryError` if the output cannot be allocated.
